subject.title: autoreview: SSH/URL userinfo over-masked to "redacted" (incl. f-string slots), causing false-positive findings

question: Should the reported URI-userinfo regressions be incorporated into https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/132 or fixed first as a narrow change on current main?
rationale: Both paths touch the same masking subsystem, and the open rewrite is not yet merged or proven against these exact inputs; selecting the landing vehicle requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Fold into the rewrite
options.body: Add these URI-userinfo fixtures and preserve password-only redaction in the active rewrite before it lands.

options.title: Land a narrow correction first
options.body: Make a focused current-main collector fix with regression tests, then rebase the rewrite over that established behavior.

recommendation.title: Fold into the rewrite
recommendation.body: Add these URI-userinfo fixtures and preserve password-only redaction in the active rewrite before it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent fixes and the open rewrite identified as the overlapping implementation path.
